answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The reef edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 62 clones produces a signature the garden analysis flags immediately. An copycat must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, so that doing work rather than printing keys, and the falcon settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 28 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
